summary: A full refund is auto-approved when any of these is true. Amount $25 or less. Changed mind, delivered within 14 days. Arrived damaged, amount over $50. Wrong item.

review_notes.text: Picking error is not a stated reason. This is a reviewer note.
Partials for cosmetic damage are the reviewer's call.
Partials for late delivery are the reviewer's call.
Never arrived: if the carrier has a signature or delivery photo, we reject unless the carrier opens an investigation.
Fraud flag: goes to the fraud team. If they confirm the card was stolen, refund the real cardholder in full.
Every chargeback costs us the order amount plus a $25 fee, and too many put our card processing at risk.
